name: Jonas
source:
The proprietor of the [i]Mosspoint Cafe[/i]. Has the tendency to mysteriously disappear and re-appear when least expected. Supportive, understanding, and takes great pride in his craft.

[From [URL=https://neonpolygon.itch.io/monster-cafe]the official website[/URL]]
